title: GuardAgent: A Memory-Augmented Agentic Framework for Adaptive Detection of Adversarial Promotions in LLM-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In traditional recommender systems (RSs), textual information typically serves as auxiliary signals for representation learning. In contrast, in LLM-based RSs, textual information becomes the primary medium for recommendation generation through semantic understanding and reasoning. This shift fundamentally changes the attack surface, making promotion-driven manipulations more feasible, effective, and harder to detect. However, effectively detecting such attacks remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic study on detecting promotion-driven attacks against LLM-based RSs, aiming to safeguard next-generation recommendation platforms. Specifically, we propose GuardAgent, a novel LLM-powered agentic detection framework that operates through a loop of Perception, Action, Reflection and Memory. translated_title: GuardAgent：一种记忆增强的智能体框架，用于自适应检测基于大语言模型推荐系统中的对抗性推广攻击
translated_abstract: 在传统的推荐系统（RS）中，文本信息通常作为表示学习的辅助信号。相比之下，在基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统中，文本信息通过语义理解和推理成为推荐生成的主要媒介。这一转变从根本上改变了攻击面，使得推广驱动的操纵行为更加可行、有效且更难被检测。然而，如何有效检测此类攻击在很大程度上仍处于未探索状态。为填补这一空白，我们首次针对基于LLM的推荐系统的推广驱动攻击检测开展了系统性研究，旨在保护下一代推荐平台。具体而言，我们提出了GuardAgent，这是一种新颖的由LLM驱动的智能体检测框架，它通过感知、行动、反思和记忆的循环机制运行。与传统的静态、一次性且不透明的LLM检测器不同，GuardAgent...
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对基于大语言模型推荐系统的推广驱动攻击检测的系统性研究，设计了通过感知-行动-反思-记忆循环运作的智能体框架GuardAgent，以实现对攻击的自适应检测。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study on detecting promotion-driven attacks in LLM-based recommender systems, proposing GuardAgent, a memory-augmented agentic framework that adaptively detects adversarial promotions through a Perception-Action-Reflection-Memory loop.
